director.text: Hello Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket pitch jaise place karenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Theek hai Riya, koi baat nahi—cricket interest zaroori nahi. Socho, 1 metre pitch ko 2 barabar hisson mein baantenge; ek hissa kaise likhoge?
Riya, 0 se 1 tak ek poori roti socho; use 2 barabar tukdon mein kaato. Har tukda kitna hoga?
Haan Riya, dheere chalenge. 0 se 1 tak line ko 5 barabar gaps mein baanto. Har gap kitna hoga?
Hindi mein? Zaroor. Riya, 0 se 1 tak ki rekha ko 5 barabar hisson mein baanto. Har hissa ek-paanchvaan hai. 2/5 ke liye kitne hisse gino?
Riya, tumne 5 kaha—yeh kul barabar hisson ki sankhya hai. 2/5 ke liye 0 se kitne hisse ginna hoga?
Ek udaharan dekho, kadam se kadam. Diya hai: 2/5, 0 aur 1. Pehle: 5 barabar hisse. Ab tak samajh aaya?
Riya, 0 se 1 tak paanch barabar hisse hain. 2/5 ka matlab 0 se do hisse. Doosre nishaan par kaunsa bhinn hai?
Riya, “haan” se lagta hai tumne baat pakdi. Doosra nishaan 2/5 hota hai, kyunki hum 0 se do hisse ginte hain. Tum 2/5 bolo.
Riya, tumne 7 likha. 2/5 mein 2, ginte hue hisson ki sankhya hai; 5 kul hisse hain. Middle se pehle ya baad?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai Riya, tum aaj ke liye rukna chahti ho. Jaari rakhein, thoda viraam lein, ya aaj khatam karein?
